hook: What if you could claim 7 square kilometers of land between two nations?

sections.voiceover: What if you could claim 7 square kilometers of land between two nations?
In 2014, Vít Jedlička identified Gornja Siga as unclaimed land on the Danube River. Do Croatia or Serbia legally own this 7 square kilometer parcel near Zmajevac and Bački Monoštor?
Jedlička founded the micronation of Liberland here in 2015, which Croatia considers a territorial threat.
Croatia and Serbia dispute this 7 square kilometer zone along the Danube River since 2015.
Gornja Siga remains a disputed 7 square kilometer border zone.
